_doc: build_dx12.py VGPR check: the RGA (gfx1201) USED_VGPRs bound of every Swin / bottleneck kernel (a name with a swin_ part). Each bound is the largest count that keeps the kernel's present occupancy: VGPR file 1536 per SIMD lane, granule 8, a 256-lane wave32 workgroup = 4 waves on each of a CU's 2 SIMDs, so 2 workgroups per CU need <= 192, 3 need <= 128 (a 128-lane workgroup = 2 waves per SIMD: 4 per CU need <= 192). A kernel over its bound fails the build (a merge or an edit lost a workgroup per CU: swin_block_c96_add_xe_* at 215 VGPRs ran 1 per CU, +38 us per frame at 1440p Q). A new Swin / bottleneck kernel needs an entry. Model L wave 3 (the *_w3 / *_gp kernels, WG_L_W3): without LDS staging (SW_DIRECT_W) the registers alone set the occupancy: the C = 32 blocks stay within 96 (16 waves per SIMD: 4 workgroups per CU), the C = 64 blocks within 128 (3 per CU by registers; the LDS no longer limits them). WG_DX12_VGPR_CHECK=0 skips the check.
